assessment.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí akutnímu energetickému a bezpečnostnímu šoku kvůli geopolitickým konfliktům na Blízkém východě a stupňující se eskalaci války na Ukrajině, kde roste riziko ruských provokací a útoků na hranicích NATO. Politickou stabilitu v regionu navíc zatěžují sílící tlaky na migrační politiku, hrozby protivládních protestů a diskuse o mimořádných daních pro energetické giganty.
assessment.security_status_en: Europe is facing an acute energy and security shock driven by Middle Eastern geopolitical conflicts and escalating warfare in Ukraine, amplifying the risk of Russian provocations near NATO borders. Political stability is further strained by intensifying migration pressures, rising anti-establishment protests, and looming windfall tax debates targeting energy firms.

recommendations.sector_cs: Široký evropský akciový trh (Euro Stoxx 50 ETF)
recommendations.reason_cs: Trhy čelí silnému tlaku kvůli prudce rostoucím cenám energií, hrozbám sektorových daní a politické nestabilitě před klíčovými volbami.
recommendations.reason_en: Markets face severe headwinds from surging energy prices, regulatory windfall tax threats, and rising political instability ahead of major elections.

recommendations.sector_cs: Evropské banky (BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Santander)
recommendations.sector_en: European Banks (BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Santander)
recommendations.reason_cs: Bankovní sektor vykazuje odolnost vůči sazbám, ale rostoucí makroekonomická nejistota a geopolitické riziko omezují další růstový potenciál.
recommendations.reason_en: The banking sector remains resilient against interest rate paths, but mounting macroeconomic uncertainty and geopolitical risks cap further upside.

recommendations.reason_cs: Zhoršující se bezpečnostní situace na východním křídle NATO a hrozba ruských provokací zajišťují trvalý přísun vládních zakázek a vysokou poptávku.
recommendations.reason_en: Worsening security dynamics on NATO's eastern flank and the constant threat of Russian provocations guarantee robust government orders and high demand.

recommendations.reason_cs: Zatímco vysoké ceny komodit krátkodobě navyšují tržby, politický tlak na zavedení plošných neočekávaných zisků (windfall taxes) představuje zásadní regulační riziko.
recommendations.reason_en: While high commodity prices boost near-term revenues, intense political pressure for bloc-wide windfall taxes introduces significant regulatory risk.

recommendations.reason_cs: Kombinace dražších pohonných hmot, slábnoucí spotřebitelské poptávky a rostoucí mezinárodní konkurence nadále těžce doléhá na marže automobilek.
recommendations.reason_en: A combination of soaring fuel costs, weakening consumer demand, and rising international competition continues to weigh heavily on automotive margins.

recommendations.sector_cs: Pražská burza: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group
recommendations.sector_en: Prague Stock Exchange: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group
recommendations.reason_cs: Domácí tituly jsou vystaveny regionálním energetickým rizikům a celkovému zhoršení nálady na evropských trzích, fundamenty bank však zůstávají stabilní.
recommendations.reason_en: Domestic equities are exposed to regional energy shocks and souring European sentiment, though underlying banking fundamentals remain steady.

assessment.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další volatilitu na energetických trzích a zostřenou rétoriku ohledně posílení východního křídla NATO v reakci na hrozbu ruských eskalací.
assessment.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened volatility in energy markets and intensified rhetoric regarding eastern NATO reinforcement are expected in response to escalation risks.

articles.title: Record fuel prices across EU prompt calls for bloc-wide windfall tax on firms
articles.summary:
German minister says companies are ‘exploiting situation’ in Middle East, as sky-high prices become major domestic issue for leaders

European governments have discussed imposing a bloc-wide windfall tax on energy companies, as near-record fuel and gas prices pile pressure on leaders desperate to contain mounting public discontent and the challenge of the far right.

With elections due next year in eight EU countries including France, Italy, Spain and Poland, leaders are scrambling to head off the potential fallout from what analysts have warned could be one of the continent’s biggest energy shocks in decades.

articles.title: ‘My fear was too great’: the Pussy Riot member recruited by Russian spies to inform on fellow activists
articles.summary:
Exclusive: In her first media interview since fleeing Russia, Rita Flores describes her three years of being run by the FSB

First came the blackmail and death threats to secure cooperation, then came a series of tasks, each more sinister than the last: to inform on fellow activists, to elicit personal information from protest-minded artists and – eventually – to help with a plot to kidnap and murder a Kremlin enemy.

That is how Rita Flores, a 29-year-old Russian artist, activist and former member of the Pussy Riot collective, described her recruitment and three-year handling by officers from Russia’s FSB security service, a cooperation she only broke when she fled the country last month.

articles.title: Meditating by the Dnipro: I’m an artist in Ukraine, searching for peace and a life between the missiles | Anna Ivanenko
articles.summary:
Sometimes, you can remember what ordinary life was like before Russia’s invasion. Then reality comes screaming back

Sometimes, where I live in Kyiv, I hear people say: “This feels pre-war.” It refers to situations that remind us of what life was like before. You could call it a “sense of normalcy”.

For example, it refers to being able to walk around at night, travel abroad or plan your life at least six months in advance. Simple, everyday things have become a lost luxury.
